issues.reason: NuGet declares MIT; pinned upstream LICENSE is LGPL 2.1, documentation contains LGPL 3, and managed source headers grant Library GPL version 2 or later. No sole-MIT conclusion is approved.
issues.resolution: Record authoritative clarification or an explicitly reviewed LGPL distribution basis, preserving the applicable notices and all embedded component rights.

issues.reason: DBF/ParseDBF.cs credits a CodeProject article; upstream README attributes it to Brian Duke. The original article license could not be verified. CPOL or MIT must not be guessed.
issues.resolution: Preserve and verify the original grant for the incorporated DBF code, obtain permission, or replace the affected implementation with code of verified provenance.

issues.reason: Existing VSIX files contain the library DLL but not a reviewed corresponding-source distribution or a verified replacement/relink procedure. A GitHub link alone is not treated as satisfying LGPL distribution obligations.
issues.resolution: For an LGPL distribution, prepare matching complete library source, build/install instructions and a verified replacement/relink path, and deliver the required license texts and source access with the binary. Alternatively document a valid different grant covering all shipped code.
